js.home: const cate = env.get("category", "");const page = Number(env.get("page", 1) || 1);const p = page || 1;let basePath = "/anime/ai/";if (cate) {if (cate.indexOf("t:") === 0) {basePath = "/anime/tag/" + cate.slice(2) + "/";} else if (cate.indexOf("c:") === 0) {basePath = "/anime/" + cate.slice(2) + "/";}}const url = p <= 1 ? (env.baseUrl + basePath) : (env.baseUrl + basePath + "page/" + p + "/");const html = await req(url);const out = [];const seen = {};const re = /<a[^>]*href="(\/anime\/(?:ai|lifan|3d|paomian)\/(\d+)\/)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g;let m;while ((m = re.exec(html)) && out.length < 60) {const id = m[2];if (seen[id]) continue;seen[id] = 1;const inner = m[3];if (!/<img/.test(inner)) continue;const cm = inner.match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/) || inner.match(/src="([^"]*upload[^"]*)"/);const cover = cm ? cm[1] : "";const am = inner.match(/alt="([^"]*)"/);let title = am ? am[1] : "";if (!title) title = inner.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").trim();if (title && title.length > 1) {out.push({ id: "/anime/ai/" + id + "/", title, cover, remark: "" });}}return out;
js.detail: let id = env.get("movieId", "");if (!id) return { id: "", title: "", cover: "", playlist: [] };const m = String(id).match(/(\d+)/);if (m) id = m[1];const jsonStr = await req(env.baseUrl + "/api/dm/anime/" + id + "/");const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr).data;const eps = (data.episodes || []).map(ep => {const n = ep.sort_no || ((ep.index || 0) + 1) || 1;const label = ep.label || ("EP" + String(n).padStart(2, "0"));const t = ep.title && ep.title !== label ? (" " + ep.title) : "";return { text: label + t, url: env.baseUrl + "/api/dm/anime/" + id + "/episodes/" + n + "/stream" };});if (!eps.length) {eps.push({ text: "EP01", url: env.baseUrl + "/api/dm/anime/" + id + "/episodes/1/stream" });}return { id: "/anime/ai/" + id + "/", title: data.title || "", cover: data.cover || "", remark: "AI漫剧", desc: data.intro || "", playlist: [{ title: "播放线路", videos: eps }] };
js.search: const wd = env.get("keyword", "");if (!wd) return [];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/search-result/" + encodeURIComponent(wd) + "/");const $ = kitty.load(html);const out = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/\/anime\/ai\/(\d+)\//);if (m && out.length < 30) {const id = m[1];const img = $a.find("img").first();let cover = img.attr("data-src") || img.attr("src") || "";if (cover && cover.includes("placeholder")) cover = "";let title = img.attr("alt") || $a.attr("title") || "";if (!title) title = $a.text().replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();const key = "/anime/ai/" + id + "/";if (title && title.length > 1 && !out.some(x => x.id === key)) {out.push({ id: key, title, cover, remark: "AI漫剧" });}}});return out;
